findings.summary: Cluster 5b extracts three new helper methods (handleFieldTab at job-3.diff:303-311, clearFormAndReturnToList at :411-420, updateActiveTextInput at :456-469) that replace duplicated add/edit tab-switch, esc-clear and textinput-passthrough logic in SourceModal.Update. No test in the diff or already in the tree exercises SourceModal.Update with a KeyMsg in "add" or "edit" mode at all (grepped tui/internal/ui/*_test.go for activeField, "tab"/"esc" key literals, and the three new method names -- no matches; source_modal_test.go's own tests only call LoadSources/UpdateContent/View, never Update). This is a real consolidated seam the work order's stakes clause binds ("Every consolidated seam keeps or gains a test that fails if a caller's behaviour changes"), and it ships with none: a regression that broke the Tab field-swap or the esc-clear-and-return-to-list flow in either mode would pass every check the gate runs. The triage's cluster 5b write-up (docs/work/dedup-triage.md:321-330) only asserts the two blocks were byte-identical pre-consolidation and does not itself flag a test gap the way it does for cluster 6 (:361-365), but the work order's own binding stakes language is not scoped to only the gaps the triage happened to name.
